findings.evidence: Every step is base-point agnostic: `last_sub_neg_ne_zero` (L85-91) is pure algebra; `compactForm_last_sub_neg_pos` (L93-96) is `posDef_realCliffordForm_zero`; `hform` (L215-218) needs only `Q e = 1 = Q x`; `QuadraticMap.reflection_apply_self` and `reflection_sub_apply_eq_of_map_eq` (OrthogonalGroup.lean:461,567) are general in the vector. The PR's own boundary lists 'transport the neighborhood to every sphere point' as downstream work, which the `e`-general form supplies directly (multiply the `e₁`-based section by a fixed element carrying `e₀` to `e₁`) instead of requiring separate translation machinery.
findings.fix: Parametrize: `(n : ℕ) (e : Fin n → ℝ) (he : realCliffordForm n 0 e = 1)` throughout (e.g. `realCliffordSpinUnitNeighborhood e : Set {x // realCliffordForm n 0 x = 1} := {x | x.1 ≠ -e}`, `realCliffordSpinLocalSectionDirection e x := (Real.sqrt (realCliffordForm n 0 (e - -x)))⁻¹ • (e - -x)`, `realCliffordSpinLocalSection e he x`, and the action theorem `spinVectorAction _ (realCliffordSpinLocalSection e he x) e = x.1`). Recover the present statements by instantiating `e := Pi.single (Fin.last n) 1` with `realCliffordForm_unitVector (n+1) (Fin.last n)`; the proofs go through verbatim since `he` replaces the two `realCliffordForm_unitVector` appeals.
findings.issue: Under-generalization in the base vector. `realCliffordSpinLastUnitNeighborhood`, `mem_...`, `isOpen_...`, `realCliffordSpinLastLocalSectionDirection`, `..._form`, `realCliffordSpinLastLocalSection`, `..._apply`, `continuousOn_...` and `..._action` all fix `Pi.single (Fin.last n) 1`, yet the only property of that vector any proof uses is `realCliffordForm (n+1) 0 e = 1` (lines 128-131, 204-205, 215-218); positivity comes from `posDef_realCliffordForm_zero` alone (lines 93-96). The `n + 1` index shape is forced only by `Fin.last n`.

summary: The section is hard-coded to the last coordinate unit vector, but no proof in the file uses anything about that vector beyond `Q e = 1`; the base vector should be a parameter, which also removes the artificial `n + 1` index shape and makes the whole sphere coverable without extra transport machinery.
